items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: and another man named Tom Sanders William, he would sing.

ctx.x: Did you, would you all sing Christmas carols? Uh, no, it was spiritual songs.

Strictly spiritual. You know, um, because like I said, you know the majority of the people back then were, were Christian people. See, it was more Christian, more Christianized and it was more real than it is now because I believe there's a lot of phonism with the thing now. But back then, it was real. You would, uh, you know, my aunt would sing, my uncle would sing, uh, and another man named Tom Sanders William, he would sing. And you see, there would just be one big singing thing. Drinking and singing and…
Trying to be better than mine.
